title: Evergreen Review
hook: Your notes app is full of good ideas you'll never find again.
statement: Refresh your notes, tasks, and files on a schedule so the system stays useful.
explainer: Good info is useless if you can't find it or trust it. Neglect drags down even great content until the whole system just feels like clutter.
sop: Clear your capture inbox weekly. Route every item.
Do a monthly pass across notes, tasks, and files.
Score Maintenance and Relevance from 1 to 10.
Flag things that need another look instead of letting them rot.
Archive anything that's stopped being relevant.
equation_example: Maintenance 3, Relevance 8. 3 × 8 = 24. Low, because neglect drags it down. Raise Maintenance to 8: 8 × 8 = 64. Higher means a system you trust. Lower means even good info is basically lost.
question: Pick one inbox, folder, or notes app to clean out and put it on this week's calendar.
closing_statement: Even good content rots without maintenance.
caption:
Principle Nº 225: Evergreen Review
